basic_info.description: Experience modern luxury and everyday ease at One Hawthorne. This sophisticated 1BD condo balances style and function with a kitchen that flows seamlessly into the living area, complete with sleek cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, and a large breakfast bar ideal for entertaining. The bedroom accommodates a king-sized bed and boasts a walk-in closet, while the office nook flexes to fit your lifestyle - home office or intimate conversation corner. Expansive windows frame city views and bathe the home in natural light, complemented by new plank floors, in-unit laundry, and AC that elevate everyday comfort. Amenities include a dramatic rooftop terrace with BBQ and sweeping vistas, a fully equipped fitness center, full-time front desk, valet with EV charging, and secure bike storage. Outside your door, discover SFMOMA, Salesforce Park, and world-class dining just moments away. With a Walk Score of 97 and Transit Score of 100, this is highrise living at its best.
